name: hue
tagline_zh: 说一句“生成设计技能”，它就从截图或灵感里提炼出专属设计语言，还能混搭改造你已有的技能——像给AI装了个设计基因编。
tagline_en: Say 'create a design skill' and it distills a unique design language from screenshots or vibes—plus remixes your.
desc_en: Meta-skill that generates new design language skills. Works on Claude Code and Codex. Use when the user says 'create a design skill', 'generate design language', 'new design system skill', 'design skill inspired by X', 'design skill from this screenshot', '/hue', or 'use hue'. Also triggers for 'remix my design skill' or 'make my skill more X'.
why_zh: 同类只会套模板，它却把设计语言变成可复用的元技能，跨Claude和Codex，连“更潮一点”这种模糊需。
why_en: Unlike template-fitters, it turns design language into a reusable meta-skill across Claude and Codex, even turning vague 'make.
